run_extract_constraints: run the extract script to extract random phrase constraints from tab-separated source-target pairs via stdin
run_extract_multiple_phrases: run extract with --number to extract multiple random phrases of a given length from each target sentence
run_extract_with_sos_eos: run extract with --add-sos and --add-eos flags to wrap target sentences with start and end tokens
run_extract_with_seed: run extract with --seed for reproducible random phrase extraction from reference files
review_get_phrase: review the get_phrase function that extracts a phrase from a word list and removes those words in place
